notes: Three routes in the text. «قال عقبة حدثنا» names no next transmitter; I read it as the taḥwīl convergence on محمد بن جعفر (the branch it joins). This is a reading, not a written name.
The shaykh pair «عقبة بن مكرم العمي وأبو بكر بن نافع» is split across two groups because the text gives each a different next name.
«أمه» is a bare relation (rule 7). The archive's three-route flag is a hint, not a reason to change the reading.
